welcome.title: Two steps to get started
welcome.stepOpen: Open any web page and click the extension's toolbar icon.

model.none: No models yet. Add a connection in settings.

empty.setupBody: Use your own API key. It stays on this device.
empty.title: How can I help?
empty.tip: / for commands · @ to attach a page, selection or tab
empty.body: Ask about this page, or give me a task to do in your tabs.

examples.plans: Find Rogers mobile plans under $60/month and compare them in a table
examples.compare: Compare 65W USB-C chargers on Amazon and AliExpress by price and delivery
examples.process: How do I transfer my phone number to Rogers? List the steps

empty.tabsTip: Each tab has its own chat.

composer.placeholderNoModel: Add a model in settings first
composer.defaultPrompt: Please look at the attached content.

modes.queryHint: Reads, searches and follows links. Changes nothing.
modes.autoHint: Works by itself. Asks before payments, deletions and other high-risk steps.
modes.manualHint: Reads and searches by itself. Asks before every change.

context.accessDenied: No access to this site, so the page wasn't attached.
context.noSelection: Nothing is selected on the page.
context.captureFailed: Couldn't read the page. Reload it and try again.

summarize.label: Summarize
summarize.prompt: Summarize the key points of this page.

translate.label: Translate
translate.prompt: Translate the attached content into {{language}}. If it is already in {{language}}, translate it into English.

explain.label: Explain
explain.prompt: Explain the selected text in plain words.

extractTables.label: Extract tables
extractTables.prompt: Extract the structured data on this page (prices, plans, specs, lists) as Markdown tables.

message.editHint: Replaces this and the replies after it
message.diagramError: Couldn't draw this diagram. Its source:
message.linkData: This link's address carries data (an email, a long code). Check it, then click again to open:

errors.auth: The API key was rejected. Check it in settings.
errors.forbidden: Access denied (403). Check the key's permissions or region.
errors.notFound: Not found (404). Check the base URL and model ID.
errors.rateLimit: Rate limit or quota reached. Wait, or check your balance.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the provider. Check your network and the base URL.
errors.noModel: No model selected. Choose one in settings.
errors.noKey: This connection has no API key.
errors.insecure: This would send your API key unencrypted. Use an https:// address; http only works for this computer.

connections.title: Model providers
connections.description: One connection per provider. Keys stay on this device and go only to that provider.
connections.noModelList: No model list. Type model IDs under Model roles.
connections.keyHint: Tip: use a separate key with a spending limit.
connections.keyKeep: Saved. Leave empty to keep it
connections.noModelsEndpoint: No model list from this service. Save it, then type a model ID under Model roles.

validation.baseURL: Enter a valid http(s) base URL.
validation.permission: Allow access to this API host when Chrome asks.

hints.region: Mainland China and international accounts use different endpoints. Change the base URL if needed.
hints.ollama: Ollama blocks extensions by default. Start it with OLLAMA_ORIGINS=chrome-extension://* and try again.

slots.title: Model roles
slots.description: Which model does which job. Mix providers freely.
slots.typeModelId: No model list here. Type the model ID.

chat.title: Current model
chat.description: Answers and operates pages (needs tool calling). Switch it in the panel header.

fast.title: Fast model
fast.description: Extracts information from long pages. Pick a cheap one.

vision.title: Vision model
vision.description: Reads screenshots when the current model can't see images.

sites.title: Site access
sites.description: Sites and API hosts this extension may use. Each is asked for on first use.
sites.policiesDescription: What the agent may do on a site. A rule for example.com covers its subdomains.
sites.defaultPolicy: Other sites follow the mode in the side panel. The stricter of rule and mode wins, except that Automatic sites skip Manual approval. High-risk steps always ask.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language. Replies follow the language you write in.

data.title: Data
data.description: Everything is stored in this browser. Back it up, move it, or erase it.
data.exportHint: Settings and conversations in one file.
data.encryptHint: AES-256. The password isn't saved: lose it and the file can't be opened.
data.includeKeysHint: Encrypted with the rest of the file.
data.keysNeedPassword: Keys are exported only in an encrypted file.
data.importHint: Replaces your settings and adds the file's conversations.
data.importInvalid: This isn't a Browser Helper Lite export.
data.wrongPassword: Wrong password, or the file is damaged.
data.importConfirm_one: Replace your settings and add {{count}} conversation?
data.importConfirm_other: Replace your settings and add {{count}} conversations?
data.clearHint: Messages, attached pages and task records. Settings stay.
data.clearConfirm: Delete every conversation? This can't be undone.
data.resetHint: Conversations, settings, API keys, site rules and site access.
data.resetConfirm: Erase all conversations, settings and API keys? This can't be undone.

about.title: About
about.updateSteps: Run this again, then click reload on the extension's card at chrome://extensions. Your data stays.
about.autoCheckHint: Asks GitHub for the latest version. Nothing about you is sent.
about.privacy: No Browser Helper server. Conversations stay in this browser; requests go straight to your providers.
about.keys: API keys stay in the extension's storage. Web pages can't read them.

agent.busy: A task is already running here. Stop it or wait.
agent.driverHint: cdp: real mouse and keyboard · dom: simulated events

approval.title: Approve this action?
approval.submitsForm: This sends the form the field is in.

reason.payment: Looks like a payment or purchase.
reason.destructive: Looks hard to undo: a deletion, cancellation or account change.
reason.confirmEach: Your rule for this site asks every time.
reason.injection: This page tried to instruct the assistant, so it now asks before changes and new sites.
reason.exfiltration: The address contains data (an email, a card number, a long code). Send it to this site?
reason.newSite: This site hasn't come up in this task.
reason.secret: The text looks like a key or token. Enter it on this site?
reason.clipboard: Pastes your clipboard into the page. The assistant can't see what's on it.
reason.frame: Acts inside another site's frame, which the assistant can't read.
reason.download: Downloads a file. Only allow files you expect.
reason.sensitivePage: This page handles account security, keys or payments, so every change asks.
reason.unseen: The assistant can't read what is drawn here. Check the picture.

permission.title: Allow this site?
permission.body: The agent needs to read and operate {{origin}}.

handoff.captcha: {{site}} wants a human check. Solve it in the tab.
handoff.autoResume: Continues by itself once the check is gone.

question.title: The assistant asks:
question.noSecrets: Never share passwords, card numbers or codes here.

paused.interference: Paused because you used the page.
paused.debuggerDetached: Paused: the debugging bar was closed. Resuming uses simulated events.

waiting.approval: Waiting for your approval in the side panel
waiting.question: A question is waiting in the side panel
waiting.handoff: Your turn. Click Continue when done
waiting.permission: Waiting for site access in the side panel

notification.question: Open the side panel to answer.

agent.maxStepsSummary: Stopped after {{count}} steps without finishing. Try a narrower task, or raise the step limit in settings.

injection.title: This page tried to instruct the assistant
injection.titleHidden: This page hides instructions for AI assistants
injection.body: They were ignored. Until this task ends, changes and new sites need your approval.

agentSettings.title: Agent
agentSettings.description: How the assistant works on web pages.
agentSettings.useCdpHint: More reliable. Chrome shows a debugging bar while a task runs.
agentSettings.cdpUnavailable: Not in this build (no debugger permission).
agentSettings.notifications: Notify me when a task needs me
agentSettings.modeHint: Also switchable below the message box, even mid-task.
agentSettings.screenshotsHint: Auto: the current model if it reads images, else the vision model.
agentSettings.autoScreenshot: Look at the screen when text isn't enough
agentSettings.autoScreenshotHint: On canvas pages, unnamed buttons and failed steps. Sends a screenshot to the model; never on sign-in, account or payment pages.

problems.permission: Allow the microphone in the tab that opened, then click the microphone again.
problems.unsupported: No speech recognition in this browser. Use a speech-to-text model instead.
problems.network: Chrome couldn't reach Google's speech service. Check your network, or use a speech-to-text model.

permission.title: Microphone access
permission.askingBody: Chrome is asking for Browser Helper. It is used only while voice input is on.
permission.grantedBody: Voice input is ready. This tab closes by itself.
permission.deniedBody: Allow it from the icon at the right of the address bar, then try again.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.description: Click the microphone to speak. Click again, or pause for two seconds, to finish.

browser.title: Chrome's speech recognition
browser.description: Free, real time. Audio goes to Google's speech service.

stt.title: Speech-to-text model
stt.description: Records, then sends the audio to your model. More accurate with mixed languages.

voice.autoSendHint: Off: the text waits in the box for edits.
voice.micHint: A tab opens once to ask: side panels can't.
voice.micGranted: Browser Helper may use the microphone.

search.title: Search
search.description: How the assistant searches the web.

browser.title: Browser search
browser.description: Google, Bing or DuckDuckGo in a background tab. Free; may meet CAPTCHAs.

deepseek.title: DeepSeek Search API
deepseek.description: DeepSeek's own search engine, billed per search.

cloudflare.title: Cloudflare Web Search
cloudflare.description: Through your AI Gateway, billed to your Cloudflare account.

tavily.title: Tavily
tavily.description: Search API built for AI agents.

native.title: The model's own search
native.description: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and DeepSeek search on their side.

search.engineFallbackHint: Used when the API fails, if allowed below.
search.deepseekHint: This connection's key and base URL are used.
search.deepseekQuestionHint: The first 128 characters of your message go to DeepSeek with each search, for better results.
search.deepseekFetchHint: Public pages are read without opening a tab. Their addresses go to DeepSeek, billed per page.
search.cloudflareTokenHint: Needs Workers AI Read and AI Gateway Read.
search.nativeHint: Needs an OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or DeepSeek model. Each search is an extra request.
search.fallbackHint: When the API fails, e.g. a wrong key or used-up quota.
search.verifyNote: The assistant is always asked to check facts on the source pages and cite them.
